sections.title: Prepare for a trip
sections.content: Use the familiar present tense to talk about preparations. Use tener que + infinitive for things you personally have to do before travelling.

sections.title: Travel preparations
rows: I have to prepare the suitcase.

items.english: I have to prepare the suitcase.

sections.content: Use tengo que + infinitive for a personal obligation: Tengo que preparar la maleta.
